modifications: Selected original record 231 samples 0–3599 (0–10 seconds) in both original channels. Decoded WFDB format 212 and converted ADC values to mV using (ADC − 1024) / 200. Serialized as JSON. No filtering, smoothing, normalization, interpolation, resampling, synthetic leads, or waveform replacement was applied. Original beat/comment annotations are included, separately from manually estimated teaching P onsets.
subtypeEvidence: The original 231.hea explicitly mentions Mobitz II. The official MIT-BIH directory labels its 0:02 sample strip as sinus rhythm with Mobitz II and RBBB. This first-ten-second export contains the isolated missed-beat comment at sample 2083 and the visible nonconducted P in the corresponding pause.
coexistingFindings: Source documents rate-related right bundle branch block; all 10 QRS events in this excerpt carry the original R label.
The wider source record also contains 2:1 AV-block periods and ectopic events. Those later sections are not included in this opening excerpt.

manualTeachingAnnotations.status: Approximate visual estimates; not validated source annotations

sourceVersusTeachingTiming: QRS anchors are exact event sample positions from the original 231.atr file. The 11 P-wave onsets are approximate visual estimates for animation only, not source-validated fiducial measurements. QRS onset, QRS duration, electrical propagation and all mechanical motion in the 3D model remain teaching approximations.
